lede: Wake Forest carries the stronger underlying team rating — +9.2 against -3.1, a 12.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Wake Forest -15.9 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Wake Forest winning 86% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is performance, where Wake Forest leads Stanford by 111 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 84% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
